title: Switzerland – Data-processing machines (hardware) – Samsung Mobile Devices
description: Bei HOCH Health Ostschweiz kommen in diversen Prozessen Mobilgeräte wie Smartphones oder Tablets zum Einsatz. Aktuell sind das sowohl Android (Samsung) sowie iOS (Apple) Geräte. Definierte Gerätetypen: . Business Smartphone . PUT-Tablet normal (Bedside) . PUT-Tablet Prestige (Bedside) . Business Tablet . Rugged Tablet Das Departement IT (DIT) beschafft, verwaltet und managed diese zentral über die EMM Lösung «Workspace ONE UEM» von Omnissa. Weiterer wichtiger, zentraler Baustein bezüglich Sicherheit und Betrieb ist zudem auch die «Samsung Knox»-Plattform. Neben einem normalen laufenden Lifecycle und Wachstum stehen umfangreichere Geräteerneuerung und -erweiterungen an. Zudem wird eine Standardisierung des Portfolios auf Android-basierten Smartphones und Tablets angestrebt. Mit der vorliegende Ausschreibung sollen die vertraglichen Grundlagen für die zukünftigen Beschaffungen ab dem 1. Januar 2027 von Samsung-Mobilgeräten sowie definierter Betriebsleistungen geschaffen werden. Ziel ist ein langfristig verfügbares, zentral verwaltbares und sicher betreibbares Geräteportfolio mit klaren Service-, Lifecycle- und Nachhaltigkeitsleistungen. Die Geräte müssen in die bestehende Enterprise-Mobility-Infrastruktur auf Basis Omnissa Workspace ONE UEM und Samsung Knox integriert werden können. Für die Ausschreibung wurde seitens Auftraggeber entsprechende Samsung-Gerätemodelle festgelegt. Für Folgebestellung gilt ein entsprechendes allfälliges Nachfolgemodell. Bei Abkündigung eines Modells gelten die Bestimmungen zu Nachfolgemodellen gemäss Lastenheft Kapitel 5.3.3. Die Zusammenarbeit wird in einem Rahmenvertrag (Beschaffungen) sowie einem Servicevertrag (Betriebsleistungen) jeweils mit einer fünfjährigen Laufzeit geregelt, welche zwei Mal für jeweils zwei Jahre optional verlängert werden kann. Die effektiven Beschaffungen erfolgen während der Vertragslaufzeit bedarfsorientiert durch HOCH Health Ostschweiz. Für die Planung der Ersatz- und Neubeschaffungen bilden insbesondere der Lifecycle Ersatz (interner Lifecycle mind. 5 Jahre), die Mittelfristplanung sowie die definierten End-of-Support-(EOS)Zeitpunkte der Geräte eine wesentliche Grundlage. Grundsätzlich erfolgen die Beschaffungen in 3-4 grösseren Sammelbestellungen pro Jahr. Es soll zudem möglich sein, Einzelbeschaffungen von abweichenden Spezialausführungen über den Rahmenvertrag abzuwickeln. Bestehende Geräte werden bis zur bedarfsorientierten Ersatzbeschaffung weiterbetrieben. Die neue Anbieterin muss keine Betriebs-, Support- oder Reparaturleistungen für Geräte übernehmen, welche nicht durch sie geliefert wurden. Defekte Bestandsgeräte werden innerhalb der Garantielaufzeit über die bisherigen Prozesse abgewickelt; ausserhalb der Garantie erfolgt grundsätzlich ein Ersatz durch neue Geräte. Zusammenstellung Beschaffungsgegenstand . Rahmenvertrag für Kauf von Samsung Mobilgeräten gemäss Lastenheft Kapitel 7 inkl. mind. 2 Jahre Garantie und 5 Jahre Ersatzteil-Verfügbarkeit. Mengengerüst für 5 Jahre (Plan): . 5'000 Business Smartphone (Samsung Galaxy XCover 7 Enterprise Edition) . 1'200 PUT-Tablet normal (Samsung Galaxy Tab A11 . 200 PUT-Tablet Prestige (Samsung Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra) . 200 Business Tablet (Samsung Galaxy Tab S11) . 200 Rugged Tablet (Samsung Galaxy Tab Active 5 Pro) . Betriebsleistungen gemäss Lastenheft Kapitel 5.3 . Einmalige Leistungen bei Kauf von Hardware gemäss Lastenheft Kap. 5.3.2 Mit Vertragsabschluss werden voraussichtlich folgende Geräte und Anzahl bestellt. . 360x PUT-Tablet normal (Samsung Galaxy Tab A11) . 100x PUT-Tablet Prestige (Samsung Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra) . 150x Rugged Tablet (Samsung Galaxy Tab Active 5 Pro) Diese Erstbestellung muss zu den offerierten Konditionen erfolgen.

title: Czechia – Intercity railway works – Elektrizace trati Havlíčkův Brod – Ždírec nad Doubravou – Hlinsko
description: Cílem Díla je prostá elektrizace úseku Havlíčkův Brod – Hlinsko v Čechách (včetně) a traťového úseku odb. Tunel – odb. Kubešův Mlýn. Součástí stavby bude výstavba nového trakčního vedení, výměna nevyhovující kabeláže, stavba nové spínací stanice SpS Havlíčkův Brod a úprava nebo náhrada nevyhovujících silničních nadjezdů. Předmětem této veřejné zakázky je rovněž poskytnutí souvisejících projektových činností, a to zpracování projektové dokumentace stavby. Projektovou dokumentací stavby se rozumí projektová dokumentace stavby dle interního předpisu zadavatele směrnice SŽ SM011 Dokumentace staveb Správy železnic, státní organizace a dle přílohy č. 1 a č. 3 vyhlášky č. 227/2024 Sb., v kompletním rozsahu určující stavbu do technických, ekonomických a architektonických podrobností, které jsou jednoznačně vymezeny předmětem veřejné zakázky dle zadávací dokumentace. Projektová dokumentace bude určovat hmotové, materiálové, stavebnětechnické, technologické, dispoziční a provozní vlastnosti díla a jakost zohledňující vliv stavby na životní prostředí a umožňovat vyhotovení soupisu prací s výkazem výměr, podrobného položkového rozpočtu jednotlivých objektů stavební části (SO) a objektů technických a technologických zařízení (PS) a souhrnného rozpočtu jako podkladů pro dílčí fakturaci v průběhu realizace stavby. Projektová dokumentace bude respektovat schválenou dokumentaci pro Záměr projektu, včetně schválených investičních nákladů. Součástí projektových prací jsou veškeré činnosti a doklady zajišťující komplexní veřejnoprávní projednání, projednání s vlastníky dotčených nemovitých věcí a zajištění všech potřebných podkladů a certifikátů nutných k vydání povolení stavby (je-li pro plnění veřejné zakázky potřebné), a to na základě plné moci objednatele. Součástí činnosti zhotovitele je i výkon dozoru projektanta ve smyslu zákona č. 283/2021 Sb., stavební zákon, ve znění pozdějších předpisů. Zhotovitel v rámci zpracování projektové dokumentace zajistí zpracování podkladů pro realizaci stavby v potřebném množství a podobě. Zhotovitel stavby zajistí zpracování žádostí o potřebné povolení záměru a zajistí jeho vydání, je-li pro plnění veřejné zakázky potřebné. Bližší specifikace předmětu plnění veřejné zakázky je upravena v dalších částech zadávací dokumentace.

description: Background Renovasjonsselskapet GLØR IKS needs to procure a compact wheel loader. The procurement shall contribute to ensuring stable and efficient operation in daily handling of materials, waste, equipment and winter assignments in the area. The wheel loader shall be used in an operational environment with limited space between containers, varying surfaces and winter conditions with snow and ice. Therefore there is a need for a compact and reliable machine that is well suited for all-round use throughout the year and that can carry out the tasks in a safe and efficient manner. The requested size of the machine and the pallet fork requirements are in the requirement specification. A 5 year service contract is also requested. The procurement also includes a service agreement, training, necessary documentation and safety training for drivers. The delivery shall, in total, give the contracting authority a complete and functional system that can be used from hand-over. The requested machine shall have good qualities for work in confined areas at the recycling stations. Central conditions are compact design, small turning range, good visibility, good driver environment and sufficient hydraulic capacity for efficient use of tools and handling waste fractions. As the machine shall also be used in winter time, good heating apparatus and suitable tyres are important conditions for the offered machine. Zamawiający wymaga, aby Wykonawca dysponował wdrożoną, sprawdzoną i kompletną technologią przetwarzania osadów ściekowych, która pozwoli na docelowe i ostateczne zagospodarowanie wszystkich produktów i odpadów powstałych w trakcie przetwarzania osadów ściekowych. Wykonawca w okresie realizacji przedmiotu umowy zobowiązany jest do: - zapewnienia naczep lub szczelnych kontenerów do bezpośredniego odbioru osadu spod podajnika ślimakowego i bezpośredniego transportu z Oczyszczalni Ścieków w Piasecznie i w Wólce Kozodawskiej do miejsca gospodarczego wykorzystania; - wykonywania obowiązku w zakresie ewidencjonowania odpadów, uzupełniania karty przekazania odpadów. Rozliczenie za odbiór osadu będzie odbywało się na podstawie karty przekazania odpadów za miesiąc, w którym usługa została wykonana. Wykonawca powinien zapewnić systematyczny odbiór osadu w ciągu całego okresu trwania umowy, w tym również w sytuacjach, gdy temperatura powietrza spadnie poniżej 0º C. Wykonawca, którego oferta zostanie wybrana i z którym zostanie zawarta umowa, w okresie realizacji umowy jest zobowiązany do posiadania wszelkich aktualnych i prawomocnych zezwoleń, zgód, decyzji wymaganych przepisami prawa, w tym wpisów do Bazy danych o produktach i opakowaniach oraz o gospodarce odpadami (BDO), w zakresie działalności objętej przedmiotem zamówienia. W/w zezwolenia, zgody, decyzje mają zapewnić odbiór i odzysk komunalnych osadów ściekowych, metodą R3 i/lub R10 co najmniej w ilości objętej zamówieniem. W przypadku planowanego odzysku komunalnych osadów ściekowych zgodnie z art. 96 ust. 1 ustawy o odpadach Wykonawca zobowiązany będzie do: a) każdorazowego dostarczania Zamawiającemu map ewidencji gruntów, na których będą rolniczo stosowane osady ściekowe z zaznaczeniem innym kolorem numerów działek i ich powierzchni, na których osady te mają być stosowane; b) wykonania w imieniu Zamawiającego badania gruntów, na których będą rolniczo stosowane osady ściekowe oraz przekazania badań gruntów Zamawiającemu (1 próbka/5 ha). Pobór i badania gruntu należy zlecać laboratorium posiadającemu akredytację na wykonywanie tego typu badań. Badania gruntów będą przekazywane Zamawiającemu wraz z mapami ewidencyjnymi gruntów oraz oświadczeniem, w jaki sposób grunty te będą zagospodarowane. c) do przetrzymania osadu w środkach transportu na czas wykonania niezbędnych badań osadu na terenie udostępnionym przez Zamawiającego. Zamawiający, na czas realizacji przedmiotu zamówienia, udostępni 23 szczelne kontenery typu Kp12. Wykonawca musi wykazać gotowość do wywozu i zagospodarowania osadów ściekowych z zachowaniem warunków określonych w decyzji na przetwarzanie odpadów procesie odzysku R3. Wykonawca wskazując grunt, na którym będą stosowane komunalne osady ściekowe, będzie się kierował zasadami bliskości, o których mowa w art. 20 ustawy o odpadach. Wykonawca jest zobowiązany do podania w Formularzu Oferty procesów oraz metod zagospodarowania osadu, zgodnie z obowiązującymi przepisami prawa. W przypadku, gdy osady nie będą spełniać warunków do ich zastosowania zgodnie z art. 96 ust.1, pkt 1 - 5 ustawy o odpadach, a także w okresie zimowym, gdy temperatura powietrza spadnie poniżej 0oC, teren na których miałyby być stosowane będą zamarznięte lub pokryte śniegiem, Zamawiający wymaga przetwarzania ich przez kompostowanie. W związku z tym, Wykonawca musi posiadać i dołączyć do oferty decyzję na przetwarzanie odpadów w procesie R3 (kompostowanie) oraz decyzję Ministra Rolnictwa zezwalającą na wprowadzenie przetworzonego odpadu jako produkt. Zamawiający dopuszcza udział podwykonawców w realizacji części zamówienia, w szczególności w zakresie transportu (odbioru) komunalnych osadów ściekowych. Jednocześnie Zamawiający działając na podstawie art. 121 pkt 1) Ustawy Pzp zastrzega obowiązek osobistego wykonania przez Wykonawcę kluczowych zadań dotyczących usługi, tj. świadczenie usługi unieszkodliwiania lub odzysku komunalnych osadów ściekowych. Zamawiający nie przewiduje udzielania zamówień podobnych, o których mowa w art. 388 pkt 2) lit. c) Ustawy Pzp.

La nivelul Primăriei sunt utilizate în prezent aplicația de taxe și impozite Avantax și aplicația de registru agricol Avanregis (furnizor: Integrisoft), precum și aplicația financiar-contabilă a instituției. Soluțiile digitale achiziționate nu înlocuiesc aceste aplicații, ci se integrează cu ele, prin interfețele puse la dispoziție de Autoritatea Contractantă, fără modificarea codului lor sursă. Astfel, proiectul urmareste dezvoltarea, testarea si pilotarea a doua solutii digitale complexe: 1. Solutia digitala de front-office – o soluție online ce facilitează digitalizarea administrației publice prin oferirea de servicii online de către UAT cetățenilor, sprijinind interacțiunea dintre Primărie și cetățean/contribuabil. Soluția de front-office este proiectată pentru a optimiza fluxul de informații între Primărie și cetățeni, adresându-se atât persoanelor fizice, cât și juridice. Platforma va permite utilizatorilor un acces intuitiv și eficient la informații relevante și personalizate. Solutia de front office va avea in componenta sa urmatoarele: Aplicatie info-chiosc (IoT); Solutie digitala de oferire a serviciilor online Servicii online taxe, Solutie digitala de oferire a serviciilor online privind registrul agricol, Solutie digitala pentru servicii online urbanism , Portal de publicare si gestionare a informaţiei, Solutie digitala Monitorul Oficial Local, Mecanism de bugetare participative, Solutie de comunicarea online de date și documente cu birourile executorii judecatorești, Solutie digitala pentru oferirea de servicii online cetatenilor, Aplicaţie pentru dispozitive mobile cu servicii partajate adresate cetăţenilor 2. Solutia digitala de back-office – un sistem informatic integrat, destinat automatizării, eficientizării și securizării fluxurilor de lucru interne ale instituției și susținerii colaborării între departamente. Conceput pentru a centraliza și gestiona datele și procesele administrative, acest sistem include funcționalități adaptate specificului operațional al administrației publice locale, asigurând o gestionare optimizată a activităților interne. Solutia de back office va avea in componenta sa urmatoarele: Solutie digitala de Managementul documentelor, Modulul de Registratura, Solutie mobile de inventariere a activelor fixe si a obiectelor de inventor, Solutie digitala de ROeID, Solutie de Arhiva electronica, Solutie pentru securitatea cibernetica de tip IDS, Centralizator date cetăţean si adresă (web si mobile), modul gestiune debite prescriptibile, solutie import trezorerie, F2201/F2202 / Popriri, Modulul Curtea de conturi, Comunicarea documentelor și datelor în format electronic structurat cu DRPCIV, Solutie de supraveghere video, Aplicație de informare cu privire la eficiența energetică. Soluțiile prevăzute în acest proiect au ca scop digitalizarea administrației publice a comunei Chețani prin furnizarea de servicii online pentru cetățeni, facilitând astfel interacțiunea directă între Primărie și cetățean/contribuabil.

title: Tupurin koulun ja päiväkodin peruskorjauksen hankinta
description: Tupurin koulun ja päiväkodin peruskorjauksen hankinta Salon kaupunki (jäljempänä hankintayksikkö / tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia Tupurin koulun ja päiväkodin peruskorjauksen hankinnasta kokonaisurakkana tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteenä olevien urakka-asiakirjojen ja suunnitelmien mukaisesti. Hankinnan kohteena on osoitteessa Taimistokatu 1 sijaitseva peruskorjattava Tupurin koulu ja päiväkoti. Urakkamuotona on kokonaisurakka. Urakkasuoritukseen sisältyvät kaikki kohteen suunnitelma-asiakirjoissa esitetyt työt, materiaalit, hankinnat ja velvoitteet, ellei suunnitelmissa muuta mainita. Urakoitsijan tulee huomioida tarjouksessaan, että urakka toteutetaan kolmevaiheisena ja urakan aikana koulu ja päiväkoti toimivat rakennuksessa ja pihapiirissä. Urakoitsijan tulee huomioida urakan luonteesta johtuvasta yhteensovittamisesta, sekä vaiheistamisesta ja koulun toiminnan turvaamisesta urakkaan aiheutuvat kustannukset. Tilaaja katsoo lisä- ja muutostyöksi vain lopullisen toteutuksen suunnitelmamuutokset. Kaikista väliaikaisista ratkaisuista ja niiden aiheuttamista kustannuksista vastaa urakoitsija. Kokonaisurakkamuoto on valittu hankkeen laajuuden, pitkän toteutusajan ja kokonaisuuden hallittavuuden vuoksi. Urakkamuoto tukee hankkeen tehokasta johtamista sekä aikataulun, kustannusten ja laadun hallintaa. Hankkeen toteutuksen merkittävin erityispiirre on se, että koulu ja päiväkoti ovat käytössä koko rakennushankkeen ajan väistötilaratkaisujen tukemana. Työturvallisuus, työmaan logistiikka, käyttäjäturvallisuus sekä häiriötön opetuksen ja varhaiskasvatuksen toiminta ovat hankkeen keskeisiä onnistumistekijöitä. Urakan tulee olla valmis vaiheittain seuraavasti. Rakennustöiden tulee olla vaiheittain valmiit ja vastaanotettu (sisätilat), sekä rakennusvalvonnan käyttöönottokatselmus vaiheen osalta suoritettu: • Rakennustyöt vaihe 1. (päiväkoti) 22.12.2027 • Rakennustyöt vaihe 2. (koulu, vanha osa) 22.12.2028 • Rakennustyöt vaihe 3. (koulu uusi osa) 1.8.2029 • Koulun keittiön saneeraustyöt tulee tehdä 1.6-15.8 2028 välisenä aikana. Välitavoitteet pihatöiden osalta: • Saattoliikennealue ja päiväkodin leikkipiha valmis ja vastaanotettu 31.7.2027 Kokonaisurakka julkisivu- vesikatto- ja pihatöineen valmis ja vastaanotettu 3.12.2029. Urakan aikataulu voi muuttua tarjouspyynnössä kuvatulla tavalla.,

description: SPET-TT laitteisto Etelä-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue pyytää tarjoustanne SPET-TT laitteistosta oheisen hankintaohjelman ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Hankintaohjelma kaikkine liitteineen on kiinteä osa tarjouspyyntöä. Hankinnan kohteena on uusi kaksidetektorinen yleiskäyttöinen SPET-TT -yhdistelmälaite, joka soveltuu isotooppilääketieteen perustutkimuksiin ja jossa on diagnostisiin TT-kuvauksiin soveltuva TT-laitteisto, jossa aksiaalikuvauksessa laitteisto pystyy mittaamaan vähintään 32 leikettä/pyörähdys. Laitteiston tulee muodostaa toimintavalmis kokonaisuus, johon sisältyvät kuvaus-, rekonstruktio-, fuusio-, laadunvalvonta-, käyttökoulutus-, huolto- ja vastaanottotarkastuskokonaisuudet. Laitteen tulee täyttää kaikki lainsäädännön ja viranomaisvaatimusten asettamat vaatimukset. Laitteisto hankitaan Seinäjoen keskussairaalan Fysiologian ja isotooppitutkimusten yksikköön. Kuvauslaitteiston tulee soveltua planaari- ja koko kehon kuvauksiin, dynaamisiin kuvauksiin, SPET- ja SPET-TT -kuvauksiin, elliptisen/non circular-pyörähdysten ja potilaan ääriviivoja seuraaviin kuvauksiin, EKG-tahdistetuihin ja kaksoisisotooppikuvauksiin, luuston, munuaistoiminnan, sydänperfuusion, sydämenoikovirtauksen, keuhkojen perfuusion ja ventilaation, vartijaimusolmukkeiden, lisäkilpirauhasen, kilpirauhasmetastaasien ja aivojen dopamiinitransportterien gammakuvauksiin. Laitteella pitää pystyä tekemään vaimennus- ja sirontakorjattuja SPET-TT-kuvauksia. Laitteistolla tulee pystyä tekemään itsenäisiä diagnostisen kuvanlaadun TT-kuvauksia. TT:n tulee ola monileike-TT, jossa yhdellä pyörähdyksellä mitattu kollimoitu leikemäärä on vähintään 32 leikettä ja rekonstruoitu leikemäärä vähintään 64. Laitteessa tulee olla muokattavissa olevat kuvausprotokollat aikuisille ja lapsille, annosmodulaatio, iteratiivinen tai tekoälypohjainen rekonstruktio, metalliartefaktakorjaus, vähintään 512 x 512 kuvarekonstruktiomatriisi, vähintään 50 cm diagnostinen kuvakenttä ja mahdollisuus laskennalliseen 70 cm kuvakenttään, vähintään 150 cm helikaalikuvaus ja mahdollisuus automaattisiin rekontruktoihin. Tarjottavan laitteiston tulee sisältää kaikki tarvittavat ohjelmistot, protokollat ja työasemat edellä mainittujen tutkimusten kuvaamista ja analysointia varten. Sydänperfuusio- ja aivojen reseptorikuvausohjelmistojen tulee sisältää viitearvoihin perustuvat analysointityökalut ja toimittajan on asetettava protokollat näihin sopiviksi. Laitteiston tulee olla varustettu erityisesti luuston gammakuvauksiin optimoidulla ja luustokertymien kvantitointiin soveltuvalla ohjelmistolla. Laitteiston tulee sisältää työkalut esimerkiksi keuhkojen SPET-TT -tutkimusten fuusiointiin ja analysointiin. Myyjä vastaa laitteiston soveltuvuudesta tässä mainittuun käyttötarkoitukseen.,

title: Rammeaftale om nedrivning af minkerhvervets produktionsanlæg
description: Bygningsstyrelsen udbyder en rammeaftale om nedrivning af minkerhvervets produktionsanlæg. Rammeaftalen omfatter nedrivningsentrepriser vedrørende de produktionsanlæg, som overdrages til Bygningsstyrelsen til nedrivning. Ydelserne omfatter blandt andet bortskaffelse af løsøre, miljøsanering, nedrivning af bygninger, fundamenter, tanke, installationer og belægninger samt jordarbejder og jordhåndtering. Opgaverne tildeles i geografiske puljer i takt med, at sager overdrages til Bygningsstyrelsen. Rammeaftalen er opdelt i 3 geografiske delaftaler: 1) Region Nordjylland, 2) Region Midtjylland og 3) Region Syddanmark, Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden. Der indgås kontrakt med én entreprenør pr. delaftale. Entreprisekontrakter under rammeaftalen indgås ved direkte tildeling på den relevante delaftale på baggrund af beliggenheden af de pågældende produktionsanlæg. Rammeaftalen træder i kraft ved kontraktunderskrift og løber i 24 måneder med mulighed for forlængelse 2 gange med 12 måneder. Tidsfrister for de konkrete opgaver fastsættes i de enkelte entreprisekontrakter. Der henvises til udbudsmaterialet. Udbudsbrevet indeholder en nærmere beskrivelse af opgaven og udbudsforløbet, og det øvrige materiale indeholder en beskrivelse af opgavens omfang.

title: Totalentreprise Øvergården bofellesskap
description: Frøya kommune ønsker å etablere 10 nye omsorgsboliger for personer med funksjonsnedsettelser sørvest for Frøya kommunehus på Sistranda. Eksisterende bebyggelse ble etablert i 1991 som Øvergården bofellesskap i forbindelse med den nasjonale HVPU-reformen. Bygget oppfyller ikke dagens krav og behov. Oppdraget omfatter riving av eksisterende bygningsmasse og bygging av et nytt Øvergårdenbofellesskap, et omsorgssenter med 10 omsorgsboliger og fellesarealer.Utflytting av eksisterende bygningsmasse er planlagt feb/ mar 2027, og det forventes innflytting i nytt bygg høsten 2028.Prosjektet gjennomføres som totalentreprise etter NS 8407. Totalentreprenøren har det samlede ansvaret for prosjektering, koordinering, utførelse, testing, idriftsettelse, prøvedrift og ferdigstillelse av alle arbeider som er nødvendige for å levere et komplett og funksjonsdyktig bygg i henhold til kontraktens krav.Totalentreprenøren skal selv vurdere og innarbeide alle ytelser, leveranser og arbeider som er nødvendige for å oppfylle prosjektets funksjons- og myndighetskrav, også der disse ikke er uttrykkelig beskrevet i konkurransegrunnlaget. Entreprenøren har ansvar for koordinering av samtlige rådgivere, leverandører og underentreprenører.Byggherren angir prosjektets overordnede mål, funksjonskrav og kvalitetskrav, mens valg av tekniske løsninger og detaljutforming inngår i totalentreprenørens ansvar. Prosjektet skal overleveres komplett, ferdig testet og dokumentert med nødvendig FDV-dokumentasjon. 6mnd prøvedrift inngår i totalentreprisen.

title: Kompakthjullaster
description: Bakgrunn Renovasjonsselskapet GLØR IKS har behov for å anskaffe en kompakthjullaster. Anskaffelsen skal bidra til å sikre stabil og effektiv drift i den daglige håndteringen av materialer, avfall, utstyr og vinteroppgaver på området. Hjullasteren skal benyttes i et driftsmiljø med begrenset plass mellom containere, varierende underlag og vinterforhold med snø og is. Det er derfor behov for en kompakt og driftssikker maskin som er godt egnet for allsidig bruk gjennom hele året, og som kan utføre oppgavene på en sikker og effektiv måte. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Oppdragsgiver ønsker tilbud på levering av en kompakthjullaster med nødvendig tilbehør for oppstart og bruk i den daglige driften. Leveransen skal omfatte maskin og pallegaffel for bl.a. håndtering av hvitevarer. Etterspurt størrelse på maskinen og krav til pallegaffel fremkommer av kravspesifikasjonen. Det etterspørres også en 5-årig serviceavtale. Anskaffelsen omfatter også serviceavtale, opplæring, nødvendig dokumentasjon og sikkerhetsopplæring for førere. Leveransen skal samlet sett gi oppdragsgiver en komplett og funksjonell løsning som kan tas i bruk fra overlevering. Etterspurt maskin skal ha gode egenskaper for arbeid på trange områder på gjenvinningsstasjonene. Sentrale forhold er kompakt utforming, liten svingradius, god sikt, godt førermiljø og tilstrekkelig hydraulikkapasitet for effektiv bruk av redskaper og håndtering av avfallsfraksjoner. Da maskinen også skal benyttes vinterstid, er godt varmeapparat og egnede dekk viktige forhold ved tilbudt maskin. Besvarelse For evalueringskriterier som ikke er MÅ-krav, vil kun opplysninger som er besvart i fritekst bli evaluert. Dokumentasjon som kun er vedlagt uten tilhørende informativt fritekstsvar, vil bli trukket i evalueringen. Oppdragsgiver kan akseptere avvik fra MÅ-krav dersom disse ansees som uvesentlige. Forbehold Eventuelle forbehold eller avvik fra konkurransegrunnlaget kan opplyses om under "Tilleggsinformasjon" ved tilbudsinnlevering.

title: Lastebil med plan og kran til Sandefjord havnevesen (ny utlysning)
description: Bakgrunn Sandefjord havnevesen har behov for å fornye kjøretøyparken som følge av utskiftingsbehov. Den nye lastebilen skal benyttes løpende til ulike oppdrag over hele kommunen. Bruken innebærer hyppig forflytning mellom arbeidssteder, betydelig kjøring på vei og et driftsmønster der kjøretøyet i stor grad vil være i kontinuerlig bruk. Anskaffelsen skal derfor bidra til en mer robust og pålitelig oppgaveløsning i den daglige driften. Dette er kunngjøring nr. 2 av denne anskaffelsen, da konkurranse nr. 1 ble avlyst. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen omfatter levering av én 2-akslet lastebil med plan og kran til Sandefjord havnevesen. Kjøretøyet skal dekke virksomhetens behov for et funksjonelt og driftssikkert arbeidsredskap til løpende oppdrag på ulike lokasjoner i kommunen. Leveransen skal inkludere komplett kjøretøy med plan og kran, tilpasset den aktuelle bruken, samt innbytte av eksisterende eldre lastebil. Anskaffelsen gjelder en samlet leveranse der nytt kjøretøy og håndtering av innbytte inngår som del av oppdraget.

title: Germany – Railway station construction work – Modernisierung VST Hagen Hbf - VP 01.3 - Neubau Bahnsteige 1&5, Ausbau PU
description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung sind die Bauleistungen zur Modernisierung des Hauptbahnhofs Hagen im Rahmen des Projekts „VP 01.3 – Neubau der Bahnsteige 1 und 5 sowie Ausbau der Personenunterführung“. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst im Wesentlichen die Baustelleneinrichtung und Baulogistik unter Eisenbahnbetrieb, den Rückbau vorhandener Bahnsteig-, Dach-, Treppen-, Aufzugs- und Tunnelanlagen einschließlich Entsorgung der anfallenden Materialien, Erd-, Tiefbau- und Entwässerungsarbeiten, Kabeltiefbauarbeiten, den Neubau der Bahnsteigkanten und Bahnsteigflächen, die Errichtung von Bahnsteigdächern sowie Ausbau- und Fassadenarbeiten im Bereich der Personenunterführung. Zu den wesentlichen Mengen gehören insbesondere: • Herrichten von Baustellen- und Lagerflächen von insgesamt ca. 2.200 m², • Rückbau von ca. 1.500 m² Bahnsteigbelägen und ca. 532 m Bahnsteigkanten, • Aushub- und Verfüllarbeiten von insgesamt ca. 2.000 m³, • Entsorgung von ca. 1.235 t Bauschutt, ca. 3.190 t Bodenmaterial, ca. 48 t Metallen und ca. 90 t Altholz, • Neubau von ca. 1.068 m Bahnsteigkanten einschließlich Fundamente und Fertigteile, • Herstellung von Entwässerungsanlagen mit insgesamt ca. 715 m Entwässerungsleitungen und 21 Schächten, • Kabeltiefbauarbeiten mit Rohr- und Kabelschutzsystemen von insgesamt mehr als 1.200 m Länge, • Herstellung von ca. 3.250 m² Bahnsteigbefestigungen aus Betonsteinpflaster einschließlich taktiler Leitelemente, • Neubau von Bahnsteigdächern mit einer Gesamtfläche von ca. 825 m², • Herstellung einer Glasfassade mit einer Fläche von ca. 740 m² sowie Ausbauarbeiten in der Personenunterführung mit Bodenbelägen von insgesamt ca. 580 m². Die Leistungen werden unter laufendem Eisenbahnbetrieb und unter Berücksichtigung der hierfür erforderlichen Sicherungs-, Logistik- und Bauphasenmaßnahmen ausgeführt. Bestandteil des Auftrags sind sämtliche hierfür notwendigen Planungs-, Koordinations-, Dokumentations- und Nebenleistungen.

title: Norway – Passenger cars – Dynamic purchasing system (DPS) for leasing and purchasing of new and used vehicles
description: Telemark Innkjøpssamarbeid (TIS) is a joint procurement unit for the municipalities: Kviteseid, Nissedal, Nome, Midt-Telemark, Seljord, Vinje and Tokke. Telemark Innkjøpssamarbeid (TIS) intends to establish a dynamic procurement scheme for the procurement and leasing of new and used passenger cars and goods vans under 3.5 tonnes as well as minibuses with up to 17 seats, both fossil, hybrid, electric, hydrogen, gas, etc. The contracting authority would like the future vehicle fleet to be considerably more climate-friendly and environmentally friendly and therefore focus on purchasing and leasing vehicles that are fossil free as long as such vehicles fulfil decisive transport needs. Increasingly more focus on circular economy means that municipalities will increasingly consider buying or leasing used vehicles rather than new ones, but it is up to each individual municipality how they will handle this. The contracting authority would like a dynamic purchasing system for future procurements of a number of different types of vehicles. The vehicles that will be procured are primarily, but not limited to: *Private car * Multi-purpose vehicle (up to 9 seats) * Goods vans (all types including pick-up) * Minibuses (up to 17 seats) The scheme shall include the following options: *Service agreements * Repairs and the accompanying parts beyond the warranty period * Tyre hotel, tyres and tyre replacement * Loan vehicles/hired cars * Collection and delivery of vehicles in connection with service, repairs etc. * Other accompanying services The tenderer, who would like admission in the scheme, shall also be able to offer a service contract, repairs with the accompanying parts beyond the guarantee period, tyre hotel, tyres, tyre replacement, loan vehicle/hire vehicle, collection/delivery and other associated services. The dynamic purchasing system is divided into seven geographical zones (see the tender documentation). Tenderers can apply for qualification (Stage 1) in one or more geographical zones as long as the qualification requirements are fulfilled. Tenderers are required to have the delivery of vehicles and workshops in the geographical zone for admission to a geographical zone. Only qualified tenderers will have access to published competitions (Stage 2). Tenderers who are qualified will be sent notification in Artifik (to a stated e-mail address) each time the Customer publishes a competition within the geographical zone in which the Tenderer is qualified. Tenderers can then choose to submit a tender in the relevant competition, or choose to abstain. The contracting authority intends to use the geographical zone that is most appropriate for travel time, but can at any time during the contract period, choose which geographical zone the vehicle would like to purchase or lease in.

description: Rauman kaupungin koulukuljetusten operatiivinen järjestämis-, ajojärjestely- ja välityspalvelu sekä joustava kuljetuskapasiteetti Palveluun kuuluvat tilaajan hyväksymien kuljetustietojen pohjalta tehtävä reittisuunnittelu, päivittäinen ajojärjestely, kuljetusten välitys, muutosten ja peruutusten käsittely, häiriötilanteiden hoito, viestintä, toteumaseuranta ja laskutusaineiston tuottaminen. Palveluntuottaja toimittaa ja ylläpitää tehtävien hoitamiseen tarvittavan järjestelmän ja käyttöoikeudet. Tilaaja tekee kuljetusoikeuksia koskevat päätökset ja hyväksyy sopimuksessa yksilöidyt suunnitelmat ja muutokset. Varsinainen sopimuskausi on 1.8.2027–31.7.2030. Tilaajalla on oikeus jatkaa sopimusta optiokausille 1.8.2030–31.7.2032 ja 1.8.2032–31.7.2033. Optioiden käyttämisestä ilmoitetaan pääsopimuksen mukaisesti viimeistään kuusi kuukautta ennen kyseisen optiokauden alkamista. Ajojärjestely kattaa sekä kaupungin erikseen hankkimat päivähintaiset ajoneuvot että tämän hankinnan perusteella järjestettävän joustavan kapasiteetin. Kaupunki maksaa nykyisten päiväautojen liikennöintikorvaukset omien sopimusten perusteella. Niiden liikennöintikorvausta ei sisällytetä tämän hankinnan kuukausimaksuun tai laskuteta uudelleen joustavan kapasiteetin yksikköhinnoilla. Palveluntuottaja järjestää tarvittavan joustavan kapasiteetin hintaluokissa 1-4 ja 5-8 matkustajapaikkaa sekä kuljetustehtävien edellyttämän esteettömyyden ja varusteet. Yli kahdeksan matkustajapaikan uuden ydinkapasiteetin hankkimista ei edellytetä. Palveluntuottaja voi käyttää omaa tai alihankintana hankittua kalustoa. Kaupungin käytettävissä oleva suurempi päiväautokalusto otetaan ajojärjestelyyn sopimustensa mukaisesti. Nykytilannetta kuvaava liite 10 sisältää vertailuviikon päiväkohtaiset ajot, päiväautojen tiedot sekä laskennallisen samanaikaisen kalustotarpeen. Viikko vastaa yhtä normaalia todellista kouluviikkoa. Päiväautot liikennöivät voimassa olevien sopimustensa loppuun. Ajoneuvojen P04, P05, P06 optiot käytetään lukuvuodelle 2027-2028. Muiden päättyvien päiväautosopimusten ajoneuvot poistuvat operoinnista sopimusten päättyessä. Voimassa olevat pidemmät sopimukset jatkuvat liitteen 10 mukaisesti. Nykytilanteen ajosuoritteet ja kalustotarvelaskenta auttavat tarjouksen laatimisessa. Toteutuvat reitit ja kuljetustarve määräytyvät tilaajan päätösten ja hyväksyttyjen suunnitelmien mukaan. Liite 10 ei muodosta joustavan kapasiteetin taattua vähimmäisostomäärää. Päiväautokapasiteetin vähenemiseen varaudutaan pääsopimuksen ja liitteiden 1 ja 3 mukaisesti.,

description: De VRH wil een raamovereenkomst met één leverancier afsluiten voor de aanschaf van uitrukkleding brandweer en de daarbij behorende dienstverlening tijdens de periode van samenwerking. Met uitrukkleding wordt bedoeld de broek en jas die de brandweer draagt tijdens een incident, met optioneel de toebehoren. Deze kleding moet daarom minimaal voldoen aan de EN 469:2020 normen, X2, Y2 en Z2. De medewerkers zijn divers in maatvoering en geslacht, de kleding moet voor alle medewerkers passend beschikbaar zijn. De VRH verstrekt per medewerker in de operationele dienst twee persoonlijke pakken. De pakken moeten bescherming geven tijdens brandbestrijding (warmte) maar ook een basis bescherming bieden tegen chemicaliën en invloeden van buitenaf. Draagcomfort, zichtbaarheid en uitstraling zijn van belang. De VRH kiest voor een losse jas en broek met bretels in de goudgele kleur en wil aansluiten op de Huisstijl uitrukkleding brandweer Nederland. De intentie is om alle ongeveer 850 operationele medewerkers van twee nieuwe pakken te voorzien. Gedurende de looptijd zullen bestellingen geplaatst worden voor nieuwe medewerkers, vervanging bij schade, slijtage of andere noodzaak.

title: Taidekasarmin muutos ja peruskorjaus, kokonaisurakoitsijan hankinta
description: Taidekasarmin muutos ja peruskorjaus, kokonaisurakoitsijan hankinta Rakennus on valmistunut vuonna 1915, ja se kuuluu Hyrylän kasarmialueen toiseen rakennuskauteen. Kyseessä on yksikerroksinen, massiivitiilirakenteinen rakennus, jossa on ullakko. Rakennuksen omistaa Tuusulan kunta ja se on asemakaavassa suojeltu kulttuurihistoriallisesti ja aluekokonaisuuden kannalta arvokkaana kohteena (sr-24). Rakennus sijaitsee pohjavesialueella. Hanke kattaa rakennuksen peruskorjauksen sekä käyttötarkoituksen muutoksen ravintolaksi. Lisäksi naapuritontille rakennetaan uusi, noin 45 m²:n huoltorakennus, johon tulee ravintolan jätetila. Huoltorakennus toteutetaan poikkeamispäätöksen perusteella ja sen tieltä puretaan nykyinen jätekatos. Huoltoliikenne järjestetään Esikunnanpolun kautta. Kunta tekee urakka-alueen ulkopuolisen varsinaisen katualueen työt. Tilaaja on aiemmin purkanut rakennuksen alapohjan betonirakenteet sekä suurimman osan yläpohjan ei-kantavista rakenteista. Peruskorjauksessa tehdään uudet alapohjarakenteet. Lisäksi sokkeli mantteloidaan teräsbetonilla, kantaviin tiiliseiniin injektoidaan kapillaarikatko ja ensimmäisen kerroksen kattoon asennetaan teräksiset jäykistys- ja vahvistusrakenteet. Osa sisäpuolisista rappauksista poistetaan, ja tiilipinnat puhdistetaan. Julkisivu ja ikkunat kunnostetaan. Ravintolarakennukseen tehdään lisäksi kaksi uutta poistumistieovea, esteetön sisäänkäynti portaineen ja luiskineen, terassi, huoltotaso ja lastauslaituri portaineen ja luiskineen sekä ullakolle johtava kierreporras. Sisätiloihin tehdään ravintolatoiminnan edellyttämät muutokset, kuten valmistuskeittiö ja kylmiöt. Ullakko otetaan osittain käyttöön IV-konehuoneina. Vesikatolle asennetaan uudet IV-konehuoneiden piiput, vesikattovarusteet sekä uudet savunpoisto- ja kattoluukut. Käyttötarkoituksen muutos edellyttää taloteknisten järjestelmien kattavaa uusimista. Rakennustöissä on otettava huomioon haitta-ainekartoitus, kunto- ja rakennetutkimukset sekä museoviranomaisen lausunnot. Ravintolarakennus ja huoltorakennus toteutetaan P1-puhtausluokan mukaisesti. Tarkemmat tekniset ratkaisut on esitetty suunnittelualakohtaisissa työselostuksissa ja erikoissuunnitelmissa. Urakka-alue on asemapiirustuksen mukainen, ja siihen kuuluu myös huoltoliikenne- ja puistoaluetta. Tavoitteena on, että käyttäjä pääsee kalustamaan rakennusta ravintolakäyttöä varten loppuvuodesta 2027 (tarkempi ajankohta tarkentuu myöhemmin).,

Die gesetzliche Verjährungsfrist der Gewährleistungsansprüche beginnt mit der Abnahme der Leistung. Ireland – Railway construction works – TII499 Luas Finglas Main Infrastructure Design and Construction Works
description: Luas Finglas is a 4 km extension of the Luas Green Line, delivering a high-capacity light rail connection between Finglas and Dublin city centre to support sustainable transport and urban development. The scheme will serve communities including Charlestown, Finglas Village, Finglas West, St Helena’s, and the Tolka Valley, and will comprise four new stops at St Helena’s, Finglas Village, St Margaret’s Road, and Charlestown. It also includes a 350-space Park and Ride facility near St Margaret’s Road, as well as interchange opportunities with bus services and with mainline rail services at Broombridge. The Luas Finglas Main Infrastructure Design and Construction Works will be delivered under the NEC4 Engineering and Construction Contract (ECC) Option C (Target Cost with Activity Schedule). The scope of this Contract (TII-499) includes, but is not limited to, the design and construction of the following principal elements: 1. Site clearance and demolitions. 2. Track (trackbed and rails). 3. Luas Stops at St Helena’s, Finglas Village, St Margaret’s Road and Charlestown. 4. Broombridge stabling site works. 5. Park and Ride facilities at St Margaret's Road. 6. Royal canal and rail overbridge at Broombridge. 7. Tolka Valley Park Bridge. 8. Fencing, retaining walls, boundary treatments and accommodation work. 9. Utility services realignment, diversion, replacement, and protection. 10. Road realignments and junction modifications. 11. Pedestrian and cycling facilities including cycle storage structures. 12. Road traffic signalling. 13. Landscape and urban realm upgrades. 14. Overhead Catenary System (OCS). 15. Power and Systems infrastructure. 16. Signalling, controls and other rail systems. 17. Working in live traffic environment on the busiest radial corridors in the greater Dublin area including property and business frontage reconfiguration. 18. Heritage / archaeology mitigation works. 19. Installation of stop furniture. 20. Installation of Validators and Ticket Vending Machines. 21. Other Ancillary works. The successful Contractor will also be responsible for: • Overall systems integration. • Interfacing and co-ordinating with other works packages to facilitate completion of works. • Interfacing and co-ordinating with stakeholders. • Testing and commissioning.

Daarnaast het leveren van betrouwbare niveaudata in het afvalwaterstelsel en oppervlaktewater bij randvoorzieningen.

title: Z1DA--537-26-101 Construction of Ogden Elevator Cab Interiors Jesse Brown VA Medical Center
description: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Jesse Brown VA Medical Center , Chicago, IL 60612 has a need for construction services for Elevator Interior Upgrades. This pre-solicitation is replacing the one numbered 36C25226B0033. Contractor shall provide all design plans, tools, materials, components, labor, quality assurance, and supervision in accordance with construction documents, drawings and specifications to complete the required construction services. The principal components of work include: upgrading the interiors of elevators P-7B, P-8B, P-9B, and freight elevator S-10B in the Ogden Pavilion. The project will include an option item for raising the sill of each elevator. Period of Performance is 154 calendar days from issuance of notice to proceed. title: Tracking Layer Tranche 4 On-orbit Demonstrations and Operations Request for Information
description: The Space Development Agency (SDA) is seeking information to inform future solicitations and reduce risk associated with the Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture (PWSA) architecture acquisition and integration plans. This RFI seeks industry feedback on enhancements to its baseline Tracking Layer�s Resilient MWTD mission payloads and architecture, as well as new mission capabilities that can help the PWSA provide enhanced mission performance to detect and track more challenging targets across their full flight trajectories. Additional details, mission objectives, and architecture information are available upon request. Responses to this RFI will specifically inform SDA�s scope and design of possible short-term on-orbit demonstration(s) and future Tracking Layer tranches. HYDROSPHERE, BIOSPHERE, & GEOPHYSICS (HBG) SUPPORT SERVICES II - FINAL REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (FRFP)
description: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), Goddard Space Flight Center (GSFC), hereby invites interested parties to review the Final Request for Proposal (FRFP) for the Hydrosphere, Biosphere, and Geophysics (HBG) Support Services II requirement supporting the Earth Sciences Division (ESD) at NASA/GSFC. The principal purpose of this requirement is to provide science research that conceives, develops, and applies space, field-deployed (i.e. airborne and in situ) and laboratory based technologies and observations to address issues of importance to society. These include but are not limited to water resources, land and ocean ecosystems, global and regional sea level change, changes in the Earth�s cryosphere, gravity field, magnetic field, solid Earth, and the terrestrial reference frame. The Statement of Work, Attachment A, describes the scope of the requirement. This contract is for support of a full range of science and research activities across the breadth of the various Laboratories that make up the HBG sub-division: the Cryospheric Sciences, Ocean Ecology, Hydrological Sciences, Biospheric Sciences, and Geodesy and Geophysics Laboratories. This contract is also for support of science, research and computing activities within the Terrestrial Information Systems Laboratory (TISL), also in the ESD. For the purposes of this document and contract the term HBG will be used to encompass all the Laboratories of the HBG sub-division and the TISL. NASA will conduct this acquisition as a small business set-aside. This competitive acquisition was originally contemplated as a Cost-Plus-Fixed-Fee (CPFF), Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract with the ability to issue CPFF task orders. Following further acquisition planning and assessment of the Government's requirements, the contract structure has been modified. The HBG II Draft Request for Proposal (DRFP) posted on April 8, 2025 was issued as an IDIQ CPFF solicitation. As amended, this competitive acquisition will now result in a HYBRID Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) with the ability to issue Cost Plus Fixed Fee (CPFF) AND Firm- Fixed Price (FFP) task orders. The contract will have an effective ordering period of five years from the contract effective date. Interested offerors are encouraged to review the solicitation and all associated attachments for complete details regarding the requirements and proposal submission instructions. Please see the attached cover letter for additional information.

title: Fuels Management Services at Malmstrom Air Force Base, MT and FE Warren Air Force Base, WY
description: Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Energy is issuing a Request for Proposal (RFP) for fuels operations and management to include bulk storage services, retail service station support, alongside aircraft services, and entire fuels management services at two Government-Owned, Contractor-Operated (GOCO) facilities, Malmstrom Air Force Base (AFB), MT and FE Warren AFB, WY. The Contractor will ensure safe, accurate, and timely handling, quality control, and accountability of all Defense-Wide Working Capital Fund (DWCF)-owned petroleum products under their control. The Contractor will perform required maintenance to ensure facilities, associated systems, vehicles, and equipment remain operational to meet the base mission. The Contractor shall provide sufficient general-purpose vehicles with appropriate capability to meet the contract requirements but not limited to escorting fuel deliveries where required, towing bowsers, transporting personnel, and performing expeditor duties as needed. The Contractor should provide sufficient special purpose vehicles with appropriate capability to meet the contract requirements for aviation and ground product services. The Contractor will comply with environmental protection, safety, and security directives. The Contractor will conduct required training to ensure personnel are fully qualified to perform Performance Work Statements (PWS) tasks. Tasks identified in the PWS are performed by either the Contractor or Agency as specified in Appendix M The Contractor is responsible for staffing, operations, maintenance, safety, security, environmental protection, training, contractor-furnished items, and Contractor Detailed Plans related to the fuel operations at the location. The Contractor shall conduct all necessary fuels operations to support base operations, airshows and special events, deployments, exercises, and contingencies under normal conditions, as well as, during periods of heightened security, inclement weather, or other unique situations. Operations must be safely and efficiently conducted to receive, store, transfer, issue, and account for fuel products with appropriate controls to ensure fuel quality, inventory accuracy, and no environmental impact. The Contractor shall operate and maintain the self-service automated service station facilities, equipment, and systems and ensure sufficient product is available to provide 24 hours a day, seven days a week support of ground fuels. The Contractor shall perform required tasks to ensure fuel is properly accounted for and issued to only authorized users. This procurement will be 100% restricted to Service Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) participation. Firms submitting a proposal under this RFP must be certified as SDVOSB by the Small Business Administration in accordance with FAR 19.1403. The NAICS Code is 493190 (Other Warehouse and Storage). The Government anticipates awarding two firm fixed-price contracts. This requirement will be for a four-year base period (April 1, 2027 to March 31, 2031), a five-year option period (April 1, 2031 to March 31, 2036), and an option to extend the contract for up to six individual months (April 1, 2036 to September 30, 2036). This procurement will be solicited under full and open competition after exclusion of sources. Interested firms may submit proposals for one location or both locations. The solicitation will be published electronically on the SAM website at https://sam.gov/. Interested companies responding to the solicitation will be required to register in the System for Award Management (SAM) and Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) prior to submitting a proposal. The Date of the Pre-Preproposal conference, in conjunction with the sites visit will be listed in the solicitation. Offerors will be required to submit in writing to the Contract Specialist (via e-mail) the name(s) and email(s) of the individual(s) who plan to attend by 11:00 AM Eastern Time on October 22, 2026.

title: Request for Proposals (RFP) for Fresh Fruit & Vegetable support for DLA Troop Support's DoW Troop and Non-DoW School and Indian Tribal Organization customers located in Dallas, TX
description: The DLA Troop Support intends to solicit a full-line of produce support for DoD (Troop) customers and Non-DoD (USDA School & Indian Tribal Organization) customers located in the Dallas, Texas Zone. This acquisition will be issued on a small business set-aside (100%) basis. A waiver of the Non-Manufacturer rule has not been requested for this acquisition because it is an acquisition for multiple items. In accordance with 13 CFR 121.406(d)(1), if at least 50% of the estimated contract value of an acquisition for multiple items is composed of items that are manufactured by small business concerns, then a waiver of the Non-Manufacturer rule is not required. As such, for this acquisition, it is expected that items comprising at least 50% of the contract value will be manufactured by small business concerns. The contracting officer must be immediately notified if it appears as though this requirement will not be met. The total length of the contract will be five (5) years. It contains one (1) twenty-four (24) month tier, and two (2) eighteen (18) month tiers. Its estimated maximum total contract dollar value is $243,976,437.00. The delivery points require indefinite quantities of Fresh Fruit and Vegetables throughout the term of the contract. A more detailed listing of the delivery sites can be found in the solicitation. All responsible sources may submit proposals that will be considered by DLA Troop Support. The Government will award a contract(s) resulting from this solicitation to the responsible offeror(s) whose offer(s) conforming to the solicitation will be most advantageous to the Government, price and other factors considered. The source selection method for this procurement will be the Lowest Price Technically Acceptable (LPTA) source selection procedures and shall use the following to evaluate offers: 1. Technical Acceptability - A technically acceptable offer is an offer that takes no exceptions to the terms and conditions in the solicitation and complies fully with all submission requirements, including submissions relating to the two subfactors listed below. A proposal that takes exception to solicitation terms and conditions or that fails to comply with all submission requirements may be deemed technically unacceptable and, thus, may be found ineligible, and removed from further consideration for the award. By submitting a proposal with no exceptions, an offeror is confirming it possesses the necessary facilities, equipment, technical skills and capacity to successfully provide all items required by this solicitation. The following sub-factors will be evaluated and must be found acceptable for a proposal to be eligible for award: A. Perishable Agricultural Commodities Act (PACA) License - The offeror shall possess and submit proof of a valid current PACA license. B. USDA Harmonized Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) Plus + Standard Audit with warehouse and food defense addenda and/or USDA Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) audit - The Contracting Officer will require an offeror to submit a valid USDA Harmonized GAP Plus + Standard audit, including addenda for warehouse and food defense, and/or USDA GMP audit, or an independent third-party certifying company audit report(s) / certificate for each place of performance identified in the offeror's proposal. The audit report(s) must demonstrate a passing score in the following parts: General, Warehouse and Food Defense addenda. In lieu of a USDA Harmonized GAP Plus + Standard and/or USDA GMP audit report / certificate, the offeror may submit an audit report / certificate conducted by a recognized private independent third-party certifying company certifying to an industry recognized food safety standard that exceeds all aspects of the USDA Harmonized GAP Plus + Standard audit and/or USDA GMP report / certificate requirements. Offerors relying on a non-USDA Harmonized GAP Plus + Standard and/or USDA GMP audit report / certificate that do not agree to have a USDA Harmonized GAP Plus + Standard and/or USDA GMP audit report / certificate for each place of performance prior to the start of contract performance will be found technically unacceptable. 2. Pricing - Pricing is required for all items found in the Schedule of Items (for Group 1 and 2 (2a and 2b), if applicable) and for all tiers. Failure to offer pricing for all items and for all tiers may result in a proposal being removed from consideration for award as technically unacceptable. The Government will perform an aggregate price analysis on all items found in the Schedule of Items (for Group 1 and 2 (2a and 2b), if applicable). To determine an offeror's Evaluated Aggregate Price for Group 1, the Weighted Aggregate Distribution Price will be added to the Aggregate Delivered Price. To determine an offeror's Evaluated Aggregate Price Group 2 (2a and 2b), the Weighted Aggregate Distribution Price will be added to the Aggregate Delivered Price for each sub-group 2a and 2b, respectively, to come to a preliminary Evaluated Aggregate Price for each sub-group. Then, the preliminary Evaluated Aggregate price for 2a and 2b will be added together to determine the offeror's Evaluated Aggregate Price for Group 2. Please refer to paragraph (d) below for further details regarding these price components. The award(s) will be made on the basis of the lowest Evaluated Aggregate Price (for each group) of proposals meeting or exceeding the acceptability standards for non-price factors. The Government reserves the right to remove item(s) from the Schedule of Items. Prior to award, the offered prices of the presumptive awardee(s) will be evaluated on an individual line-item basis to determine whether each price is fair and reasonable using analytical techniques deemed appropriate by the Contracting Officer in her/his complete discretion. A. Price Components: 1. Weighted Aggregate Distribution Price: Aggregate Distribution Price is obtained by first multiplying the proposed distribution price for each item in the Schedule of Items by the item's estimated quantity to calculate the total distribution price for each item. Then, the total distribution prices of all items will be added together to determine the total distribution price for tier 1. The total distribution price for each subsequent tier will also be calculated. The total distribution prices for all tiers will be added together to determine the Aggregate Distribution Price. The Aggregate Distribution Price is then multiplied by a weighting factor of 6 to arrive at the Weighted Aggregate Distribution Price. Note: the weighting factor is applied only to the overall Aggregate Distribution Price (not on a line item basis), and is to be used for evaluation purposes only. The Government's use of a weighting factor of 6 for distribution pricing is done in order to more accurately balance the significance of the pricing components and their respective impact on any subsequent contract(s) issued under this solicitation. 2. Aggregate Delivered Price: The Aggregate Delivered Price is obtained by first multiplying the proposed delivered price of each item in the Schedule of Items by the item's estimated quantity to calculate the total delivered price for each item. Then, the total delivered prices of all items will be added together to determine the total delivered price for tier 1. The total delivered price for each subsequent tier will also be calculated. The total delivered prices for all tiers will be added together to determine the Aggregate Delivered Price. 3. Evaluated Aggregate Price: The Evaluated Aggregate Price is obtained by adding the Weighted Aggregate Distribution Price and Aggregate Delivered Price together. 4. For purposes of the Price Proposal Evaluation, Weighted Aggregate Distribution Price and Aggregate Delivered Price are considered equal. This equality is accounted for mathematically by applying a weighting factor of 6 (based on current Government data) to the Aggregate Distribution Price. Option

description: Program Acquisition Executive Marine Corps (PAE MC) Program Manager Tactical Communications & Electromagnetic Warfare Systems (PM TCE) is assessing industry�s capability to provide Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) tactical camera systems, lenses, and accessories under a Hardware-as-a-Service (HaaS) operating lease model. The focus of this RFI is to find HAAS vendors to assist with establishing a sustainable, multi-year "Evergreen" technology refresh cycle for the Marine Corps' Visual Information Acquisition System (VIAS) Family of Systems (FoS). The HaaS vendor will be responsible for providing the latest-generation commercial equipment, managing the technology lifecycle, and executing a mandatory 36-month hardware refresh for all leased components. See component listing under Attachments section. This RFI specifically seeks information from vendors experienced in leasing, COTS technology integration, tactical kitting, and lifecycle management for Department of War (DoW) customers. See RFI Attachment for more information under Attachments section.

This project will include scope to modernize seventeen (17) elevators, as well as upgrade mechanical, electrical and fire protection equipment within the elevator machine rooms. The Courthouse will remain fully operational throughout the duration of the project. To ensure minimal disruption to Government operations, the work must be phased to limit interruptions to operations and any disruptive work must be executed after business hours, predominately work taking place within the elevator shaftways. The selected General Contractor will be required to ensure full compliance with the Government�s requirements for access and security. Additionally, the General Contractor will be required to complete this project in accordance with the construction drawings and specifications that will be issued for this project. The selected General Contractor will be required to ensure full compliance with the Public Buildings Service Interim Core Building Standards, and the U.S. Courts Design Guide. Contract Type: The contract type for this procurement will be Firm-Fixed price. The line item schedule will include a lump sum item for the Base. There will be option line items for this procurement. Price: The total magnitude of this project at award is between $20,000,000 and $40,000,000. The awardee will be competitively chosen using best value tradeoff procedures in accordance with FAR Subparts 15.1 and 15.2 (GSA Class Deviation RFO-2025-15). NAICS: This procurement will be conducted under North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code 236220--Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. The Small Business size standard is an average annual sales and receipts for the past three (3) years that are equal to or less than $45,000,000. description: The Congressionally Directed Medical Research Programs (CDMRP) seeks feedback to inform the fiscal year 2027 (FY27) Alzheimer�s Research Program (AZRP) research focus areas and associated research funding opportunities. Although FY27 federal funds have not yet been appropriated, the AZRP is collecting this information solely to support strategic program planning. This inquiry does not commit the program to incorporating this feedback into FY27 or any future AZRP funding opportunities. The CDMRP wants to hear from all audiences, interested parties, and individuals from academia, industry, community and non-profit organizations, scientific and professional organizations, federal agencies, and the public. This RFI should not be construed as a solicitation or an obligation on the part of the AZRP or the Department of War (DoW). BACKGROUND: The CDMRP represents a unique partnership between the U.S. Congress, the military, and the public to fund innovative and impactful medical research in targeted program areas. The CDMRP AZRP�s vision is to mitigate the impact of Alzheimer's and related dementias associated with TBI, military, and diverse risks. The AZRP�s mission is to fund impactful, solution-oriented research to address critical needs and improve quality of life for Service Members, Veterans, their Families, and the public who are living with Alzheimer's disease and related dementias. Appropriations for the AZRP from FY11-26 totaled $228 million. As of October 2026, FY27 funds for the AZRP have not been appropriated. If appropriated, the CDMRP will utilize its two-tier review process https://cdmrp.health.mil/about/2tierRevProcess) to efficiently manage the AZRP. description: This a combined Request for Information (RFI) and Sources Sought Notice (SSN) issued solely for market research and acquisition planning purposes for the CICP requirement. In an effort to reach the widest audience, this Notice may be cross posted on other Government buying platforms such as GSA eBuy or others. This Notice is not a solicitation, Request for Proposal, Invitation for Bids, or commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract. Responses are voluntary. The Government will not reimburse respondents for costs associated with preparing or submitting a response. Respondents should clearly identify proprietary information. HRSA is conducting market research under RFO Part 10 to support acquisition planning for Countermeasures Injury Compensation (CICP) Reconsideration Panel Support Services. The current requirement is fulfilled under a Time-and-Materials (T&M) contract No. 75R60223D00002. For the purposes of this notice HRSA is seeking industry and small business feedback to: Understand the types of businesses including small businesses who are capable of fulfilling the requirement. For small businesses, this notice seeks to specifically identify capable 8a, HUBZone, SDVOSBs, WOSB and other small businesses. Assess the feasibility of transitioning some or all of these services to a performance-based Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) structure , consistent with Executive Order 14402, Promoting Efficiency, Accountability, and Performance in Federal Contracting, dated April 30, 2026, which establishes fixed-price contracts with performance-based considerations as the default and preferred method of Federal procurement, to the maximum extent consistent with law. This Notice seeks industry feedback regarding whether the requirement, in whole or in part, is sufficiently defined to permit realistic FFP pricing and reasonable allocation of performance and cost risk. HRSA also seeks feedback regarding alternative or hybrid contract structures where FFP may not be appropriate for portions of the requirement, as well as performance measures, pricing methodology, workload assumptions, transition requirements, and small business capability. Obtain general feedback on the CICP requirement. The Government may use the information received to refine the acquisition strategy, Performance Work Statement (PWS), Independent Government Cost Estimate (IGCE), Quality Assurance Surveillance Plan (QASP), and any future solicitation. The Government is seeking sufficient information to support these acquisition-planning decisions and is not requesting proposals at this time.
